title: A2v10 mcp.json
description: In the application root: which endpoints are open to the model connected through MCP. Everything else is derived from the endpoints; an 'mcp' key of an endpoint's metadata.json corrects what derives wrong. The instructions are the plain-text file mcp-instructions.txt beside this one.

endpoints.description: Paths of catalogs and documents open to the model, '/<kind>/<name>'. The name (second segment) is the entity name the model uses; two equal names are refused. Roles come from the folder's model.json.
